er occurs. Correct PRS-RSRP measurement period requirements if handover occurs. Specified requirements when PSCell or SCell addition or release does not cause SRS reconfiguration during the measurement. Specified requirements when PSCell or SCell addition or releas causes SRS reconfiguration during the measurement period. R4-2120272 CR on accuracy requirements for positioning measurement Clarify that the maximum time offset between the two PRS resources instances for RSTD measurement is TBD ms. R4-2120271 Draft CR to 38.133 correction to NR positioning accuracy requirements Remove brackets in PRS-RSRP accuracy requirements Remove brackets in requirements for gain to PRS-RSRP measurement point Clarify the applicability PRS-RSRP relative accuracy requirements for FR1 and FR2. R4-2120275 CR to update TCs for PRS measurement requirements Add the location request IEs in the test description, and change the processing time for the assistance data and location request is 50ms where applicable. Clarify that Cell 2 and 3 are in the first and second place of the neighbor cell list such that UE will prioritize the two cells based on RAN1 spec. Add parameter for comb RE offset for RSTD test cases. In RSTD test cases for FR2, void the tables for OTA parameters. R4-2120274 DraftCR on RSTD and UE Rx-Tx test cases Align the maximum processing time of the positioning assistance data in UE Rx-Tx test cases. Align the gap pattern ID in FR2 UE Rx-Tx test case. Void the table for SRS configuration in Rx-Tx test cases but instead refer to the RMC in A.3. Add the location request IEs in the test description. R4-2120276 CR to update TC for PRS measurement accuracy Void the table for SRS configuration in Rx-Tx test cases but instead refer to the RMC in A.3. Consequences if not approved: The consequences if not approved for each endorsed draft CR are coppied below. R4-2119400 Correction to Ês and Iot symbol definitions for gNB measurements Incorrect symbol definitions, which could lead to misinterpretation. R4-2120267 Draft CR on UE positioning measurement requirements UE positioning measurement requirement is incomplete. R4-2120269 CR to update positioning measurement requirements UE positioning measurement requirements are incorrect. R4-2120421 Draft CR to 38.133 correction to NR positioning measurement requirements RSTD measurment period requirements are not finished. PRS-RSRP measurment period requirements are not finished. R4-2120272 CR on accuracy requirements for positioning measurement UE positioning accuracy requirements are incorrect. R4-2120271 Draft CR to 38.133 correction to NR positioning accuracy requirements PRS-RSRP accurach requirements are not finalized. Requirements for gain to PRS-RSRP measurement point are not finalized. R4-2120275 CR to update TCs for PRS measurement requirements UE positioning delay test cases are not fully correct. R4-2120274 DraftCR on RSTD and UE Rx-Tx test cases The test cases for UE Rx-Tx are not correct. R4-2120276 CR to update TC for PRS measurement accuracy Duplicated specification.

Proposed change affects: | UICC apps | ME | X | Radio Access Network | Core Network Title: | CR on UE transmission timing requirements for V2X Source to WG: | CATT Source to TSG: | R4 Work item code: | LTE_V2X - C ore | Date: | 201 7 - 01 - 27 Category: | B | Release: | Rel- 14 Use one of the following categories: F (correction) A (mirror corresponding to a change in an earlier release) B (addition of feature), C (functional modification of feature) D (editorial modification) Detailed explanations of the above categories can be found in 3GPP TR 21.900 . | Use one of the following releases: Rel-8 (Release 8) Rel-9 (Release 9) Rel-10 (Release 10) Rel-11 (Release 11) Rel-12 (Release 12) Rel-13 (Release 13) Rel-14 (Release 14) Reason for change: | The CR [R4-1610874] for transmission timing requirements has been approved in last meeting, however, in RAN#74 planery, due to lack of other stage 3CRs for other specifications, this CR was postponed and has to resubmit in this meeting. Moreover, regarding to timing requirements for shared Uu/PC5 carrier scenario, RAN4 RF didn ’ t define this scenario. Thus, it is necessary to remove the corresponding requirements from Rel-14 V2X specification in TS.36.133. Summary of change: | Resubmit the revised CR R4-1610874 and remove the timing requirements for shared Uu/PC5 carrier scenario from Rel-14 V2X specification in TS.36.133. {"chunk_id":"R4-2117015-001","collection":"ran4_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":[],"tdocNumber":"R4-2117015","title":"Reply LS on RRM relaxation in power saving"},"point_id":"327608285488054315"}
onse to: R4-2108230/R2-2106959 Release: Release 16 Work Item: NR_UE_pow_sav-Core Source: RAN2 To: RAN4 Cc: - Contact Person: Name: Pierre Bertrand E-mail Address: pierrebertrand@catt.cn Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: N/A 1. Overall Description: RAN2 would like to thank RAN4 for the LS on RRM relaxation in power saving. RAN2 has discussed the inconsistency raised in the LS between RAN2 and RAN4 specifications and concluded the following: 1) RAN2 agreed to follow the request from RAN4 for the change to 38.304 on RRM relaxation on inter-frequency layers/E-UTRA inter-RAT frequency layers of higher priority for the case when the lowMobilityEvalutation criterion is fulfilled and when highPriorityMeasRelax is configured, referring to clauses 4.2.2.10.2 and 4.2.2.11.2 in 38.133. 2) RAN2 also noted that in RAN4 specifications, for the case when both lowMobilityEvalutation and cellEdgeEvaluation criteria are fulfilled, referring to clauses 4.2.2.10.4 and 4.2.2.11.4 in 38.133, the UE shall search for inter-frequency layers/E-UTRA inter-RAT frequency layers at least every hour (for example, below extract for inter-frequency layers): Given the above includes the case when Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ this would result, for frequency layers of higher priority, in a less relaxed measurement requirement (1 hour measurement interval) compared with the case when only the lowMobilityEvalutation criterion is fulfilled (1 hour * Nlayers measurement interval), RAN2 kindly asks RAN4 whether this change (1 hour -> 1 hour * Nlayers) should also apply to the case when both lowMobilityEvalutation and cellEdgeEvaluation criteria are fulfilled, for consistency, or if RAN2 misinterpreted RAN4 specifications. 2. Actions: RAN2 respectfully asks RAN4 to provide their view on the above question. 3. Date of Next RAN2 Meetings: TSG-RAN WG2 Meeting #116-e 1st – 12th November 2021 E-meeting

documents.text: onse to: R4-2108230/R2-2106959 Release: Release 16 Work Item: NR_UE_pow_sav-Core Source: RAN2 To: RAN4 Cc: - Contact Person: Name: Pierre Bertrand E-mail Address: pierrebertrand@catt.cn Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: N/A 1. Overall Description: RAN2 would like to thank RAN4 for the LS on RRM relaxation in power saving. RAN2 has discussed the inconsistency raised in the LS between RAN2 and RAN4 specifications and concluded the following: 1) RAN2 agreed to follow the request from RAN4 for the change to 38.304 on RRM relaxation on inter-frequency layers/E-UTRA inter-RAT frequency layers of higher priority for the case when the lowMobilityEvalutation criterion is fulfilled and when highPriorityMeasRelax is configured, referring to clauses 4.2.2.10.2 and 4.2.2.11.2 in 38.133. 2) RAN2 also noted that in RAN4 specifications, for the case when both lowMobilityEvalutation and cellEdgeEvaluation criteria are fulfilled, referring to clauses 4.2.2.10.4 and 4.2.2.11.4 in 38.133, the UE shall search for inter-frequency layers/E-UTRA inter-RAT frequency layers at least every hour (for example, below extract for inter-frequency layers): Given the above includes the case when Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ this would result, for frequency layers of higher priority, in a less relaxed measurement requirement (1 hour measurement interval) compared with the case when only the lowMobilityEvalutation criterion is fulfilled (1 hour * Nlayers measurement interval), RAN2 kindly asks RAN4 whether this change (1 hour -> 1 hour * Nlayers) should also apply to the case when both lowMobilityEvalutation and cellEdgeEvaluation criteria are fulfilled, for consistency, or if RAN2 misinterpreted RAN4 specifications. 2. Actions: RAN2 respectfully asks RAN4 to provide their view on the above question. 3. Date of Next RAN2 Meetings: TSG-RAN WG2 Meeting #116-e 1st – 12th November 2021 E-meeting

Qualcomm: for #1 to make it work, eNB should configure one gap and de-config it and configure the other gap. Ericsson: the intention is to reduce the sync overhead. #1 for one time gap is only one way to do it. If allowing UE to request gap on need basis, the sync overhead can be reduced. We should not stick to only one method. We should allow UE to change the gaps. Intel: According RAN2 agreements there is no restriction for UE to request one gap pattern. UE can request any patterns. Qualcomm: the signalling does support UE to request the different gap. The signalling can support. Should that behaviour should be captured in RAN4. We do not think it should be captured. We have some comments on activated SCell and should define how many activated SCells. LGE: Need additional change for multi-carrier D2D. Out of coverage is covered for multi-carrier D2D. documents.text: [CR CR5697 for 38.133] CR to 38.133 on corrections to performance requirement for carrier phase measurements for positioning Clauses affected: 10.1.43.1 START OF CHANGE # 1 10.1.43 DL-RSCPD Measurements 10.1.43.1 Introduction The requirements in clause 10.1.43 shall apply, provided the UE has received NR-DL-TDOA-RequestLocationInformation message with dl-PRS-RSCPD-Request-r18[DEL]nr-DL-PRS-RSCPD-Request[/DEL] from LMF via LPP TS 37.355 [34] requesting the UE to measure and report DL RSCPD measurement together with DL RSTD measurements defined in TS 38.215 [4]. The requirements in clause 10.1.43 shall apply: - when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state and the measurement is performed with MG, - when UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state. END OF CHANGE # 1 START OF CHANGE # 2 10.1.44 DL-RSCP Measurements 10.1.44.1 Introduction The requirements in clause 10.1.44 shall apply, provided the UE has received NR-Multi-RTT-RequestLocationInformation message with dl-PRS-RSCP-Request-r18[DEL]nr-DL-PRS-RSCP-Request[/DEL] from LMF via LPP TS 37.355 [34] requesting the UE to measure and report DL RSCP measurement together with UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements defined in TS 38.215 [4]. The requirements in clause 10.1.44 shall apply: - when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state and the measurement is performed with MG, - when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state. END OF CHANGE # 2
